device_alias: Atom Voice (official C008-C product page name)

firmware.name: UIFlow2.0 Atom Echo
firmware.source_discovery: Pinned official GitHub release asset, delivered through the reviewed source: official-github-release policy introduced with AtomU. M5Burner exposes no UIFlow2 Atom Echo entry; the fetch tool verifies the catalog sha256 fail-closed.

image.image_note: The official 4,186,112-byte sparse merged image is padded to 4 MiB with 0xFF; the console probe replaces only the LittleFS vfs volume.

runtime.qemu_source_base: native-lock tree with 0113-basic-v27-board.patch and 0116-atomu-board.patch applied on top of the 0114 layer (QEMU commits 8bfdf11 -> 81594e5 -> 5a3ed3f); patch apply-check verified against 81594e5
runtime.machine_desc: M5Stack Atom Echo C008-C (ESP32-PICO-D4, NS4168 I2S, PDM microphone)

case.serial_log_note: hash of run 1; only the ESP-IDF i2c.master boot-warning virtual-time value and the injected-PCM timing-derived ATOMECHO_MIC_PCM pair vary between the three runs; all ATOMECHO_* structural markers and QOM values are stable
case.button_injection: QMP key:a through the Atom Echo input handler -> ESP32 GPIO39 input register -> UIFlow2 BtnA; the guest reports press/release and repaints the RGB value

speaker_pcm.port: I2S1 (M5Unified ESP32 classic default speaker port)
speaker_pcm.capture_note: host PCM captured at the ESP32 classic I2S1 TX DMA boundary via M5SW_I2S_PCM_FILE; byte count varies with the marker-triggered stop point while nonzero/peak are stable

microphone.fixture: deterministic 16,000-sample 16-bit host PCM injected via M5SW_I2S_RX_PCM_FILE
microphone.boundary: digital PDM RX controller path only; no real microphone, acoustics or sensitivity is validated

case.i2c_scan_note: 0x48 is the QEMU classic ESP32 machine's built-in tmp105 test device; it is not an Atom Echo component. 0x18 (ES8311) is absent. C008-C has no on-board I2C codec: the official MicroPython binary contains shared M5Unified ES8311 code but the AtomVoice board path uses the registerless NS4168 I2S amplifier.

supplementary_i2s_trace.command: M5SW_I2S_TRACE=1 M5SW_I2S_PCM_FILE=/tmp/atomecho-trace.pcm M5SW_I2S_RX_PCM_FILE=/tmp/atomecho-rx.pcm qemu-system-xtensa -M m5atomecho -drive file=/tmp/atomecho-trace-image.bin,if=mtd,format=raw -L pc-bios -display none -serial file:/tmp/atomecho-trace.serial -serial null -serial null
supplementary_i2s_trace.note: confirms speaker TX on I2S1 and PDM RX on I2S0; the two controllers are programmed separately

verified: official UIFlow2 v2.5.4 Atom Echo 4 MiB image boot through ROM and second-stage bootloader
M5.begin() and M5.getBoard()=142 in one m5atomecho guest
single SK6812 on GPIO27 driven through the ESP32 classic RMT path; host QOM decodes the final wire frame as RGB 0x204060 after 5 completed frames
QMP key:a drives GPIO39 through the board input handler; the guest reports press/release and repaints the LED
guest I2C controller on the Grove G26/G32 pins scans the bus; no 0x18 ES8311 device is present
NS4168 I2S1 standard-mode speaker path produces non-silent host PCM (47,920 non-zero samples, peak-to-peak 34,567) captured at the DMA boundary
SPM1423 PDM RX on I2S0 consumes the deterministic host PCM fixture; the guest microphone buffer is non-zero with ATOMECHO_MIC_STATUS ok
three independent matrix runs PASS with identical structural serial markers, probe image sha256 and QOM values
blocked: the NS4168 is registerless and has no modelled enable/gain control; analog amplifier, speaker acoustics and electrical behavior are not modelled
the SPM1423 path is exercised only with a host PCM fixture; real microphone acoustics, sensitivity/SNR and simultaneous record/play are not validated
the shared G33 pad between NS4168 LRCK and SPM1423 PDM CLK is a hardware wiring fact; the digital model programs both controllers independently and does not model pad contention
IR G12 is not wired or probed
Grove Unit protocols are not tested; the scan covers only the controller path
no display and no PSRAM on this board; display/PSRAM paths are not applicable
firmware source is a SHA-pinned official GitHub release asset, not an M5Burner firmware ID

the research spike task text assumed an ES8311 codec on I2S0; the official C008-C hardware and the BOARD_ID=142 M5Unified path use the registerless NS4168 on I2S1 with no on-board I2C codec, so no ES8311 model was fabricated
not_run: physical electrical, acoustic, optical or mechanical behavior
NS4168 analog gain, PA output, speaker loudness/distortion and acoustic measurements
real SPM1423 microphone capture, sensitivity/SNR and half-duplex record/play timing on the shared G33 pad
Grove Unit data planes and host-port electrical compatibility
stock UIFlow2 startup menu/network and third-party firmware
browser/WASM admission and any other classic ESP32 host (AtomU/Atom Lite conclusions are not inherited)
